title: SQL AG topology: replicas + Listener
description: The nexus-cli topology verb for the Always On AG: the 3 replicas + the Listener as the single client-facing shard.

observe.what: 3 replicas (primary + 2 secondary) + the sql-ag-listener shard at .17:1433 mapping the listener to the current primary

whatProves: the AG front door is the Listener at .17 -- clients connect there and WSFC migrates the IP across failover; topology maps it to the live primary.
